_note: July cash-register import. Sources: 'Registru Casă (Homefile) - 10.08-10.09.2026.pdf' and 'Registru Bancă (Homefile) - 10.08-10.09.2026.pdf' (data/Kralik's Documents/2026-07 folder). Both registers actually cover 10.08.2026-10.09.2026, and their first several rows (through Bancă's row #34 / Casă's row #2, ref FT262317M754 / CHHF374) duplicate the tail of what import-kralik-cash-june.ts already imported from the same two documents' earlier export (cash-2026-06.json's own window ran through 2026-08-19). This file contains ONLY the rows past that already-imported point, so re-running both scripts does not double count anything. No row sets its own `cycle` override: providerMeta.cycleCode defaults to this file's cycleCode (2026-07) for every payment, which is what PaymentService.reapplyForPeriod actually keys on to decide which period's prepare pass applies a payment (see cash-2026-06.json's own precedent — its overlap-window rows are tagged cycle '2026-07' even though their memo references Mai/Iun charges, precisely so July's prepare, not June's already-closed one, is what sweeps them in; the referenced month in each memo below is descriptive only, not the processing cycle). An earlier version of this file wrongly set `cycle` to the referenced month (2026-06/2026-05/2021-01), which excluded those rows from July's prepare entirely — fixed here. Fund label -> code per data/Kralik/history-mapping.json + funds.json: 'FOND PROIECT+REABILITARE' -> REABILITARE_1, 'Fond Pod si Fatada' -> REABILITARE_2 (funds.json altName), 'Fond reabilitare 3' -> REABILITARE_3 (explicit in the source text already). Skipped as a net-zero wash: Bancă row #8 (11.08.2026, Ap 4(III), 2742.87 lei) was never imported into cash-2026-06.json (it predates row #34's cutoff but wasn't picked up there either) and is exactly reversed by row #36's 24.08.2026 STORNARE (-2742.87) — including both would add two offsetting, non-informative ledger rows for a unit whose real 19.08.2026 payment (FT262317M754, 2690.88 lei) is already correctly imported.
